concerns.text: The plan cites OpenAlex Parquet files on HuggingFace (e.g., 'openalex-multilingual-embeddings') as the primary source for matching pre-prints to journal DOIs. These datasets contain pre-computed embeddings, not the raw bibliographic metadata (titles, authors, DOIs, affiliations) required to perform the fuzzy matching described in FR-001. The plan needs to cite the OpenAlex 'Works' or 'Authors' raw dumps (e.g., from the official OpenAlex S3 bucket or a verified raw metadata mirror) to support the matching logic. Using embedding-only datasets makes the matching step impossible.

The plan lists 'OpenAlex Extraction' (LLMDH/openalex_extraction) as a verified source. This appears to be a derived or third-party processed dataset. Relying on a pre-extracted dataset for the core matching logic violates the 'Verified Accuracy' and 'Reproducibility' principles (Constitution I & II) if the extraction logic is opaque or if the source data is stale. The plan should cite the primary OpenAlex raw data source to ensure the matching algorithm runs against the canonical, up-to-date record set.
